what: ADR-0006's acceptance test: does max_uncovered_disc_ratio predict worst-case LOCAL registration error better than the alternatives, and at what value does a 1.0 px bound get crossed?

frozen_constants.note: Part 1 section 4; not tuned in Part 2

S0.statement: full-pool fit median dense error < 0.05 px

S1.statement: |Spearman rho| of max_uncovered_disc_ratio vs p99 local error exceeds all three alternatives (real arm)

S2.statement: ROC AUC as a detector of p99 err > 1.0 px exceeds all three alternatives (real arm)

S3.statement: the max_uncovered_disc_ratio at which the 95th percentile of p99 local error crosses 1.0 px
S3.note: a measurement, not a pass/fail; reported whether or not it lands near the asserted 0.15 (D-053)

S4.statement: |partial Spearman rho| controlling for n_points >= 0.3, with the predicted sign
S4.note: if NOT MET, S1 and S2 mean nothing and must not be quoted without this beside them (Part 1 section 4)

S5.statement: the S1 winner on the synthetic arm is the same metric as on the real arm

claims_not_supported: NOT a real cross-illumination accuracy claim: self-warps share the original's texture, so every error here is an upper bound on precision (EXP-010 S1).
NOT a verdict change: assess() is not edited by this stage.
